interpretation: Among deployable adaptive policies, B3_V4 does not strictly Pareto-dominate B0: ASR point estimate is lower (0.625 vs 0.75) but McNemar p=0.125, and utility falls from 1.00 to 0.85 because HIGH false blocks. B2_L3_V4 improves security vs B0 (ASR 0.20, p=4.8e-7) at utility 0.825; it is a fixed level-3 risk-gated diagnostic, not adaptive. L3 remains the security ceiling and utility floor. ORACLE_BLOCK remains the non-deployable upper bound (ASR 0, utility 1).
